tests.name: view_dump_ensure_ascii_plain
tests.intent: Probes dumping a json_view with ensure_ascii enabled on pure ASCII strings without delete characters.

tests.name: view_dump_ensure_ascii_delete
tests.intent: Probes dumping a json_view with ensure_ascii enabled on strings containing ASCII delete (0x7F) bytes.

tests.name: view_dump_ensure_ascii_non_ascii
tests.intent: Probes dumping a json_view with ensure_ascii enabled on strings containing UTF-8 characters above 0x7F.

tests.name: view_dump_compact_ascii_keys
tests.intent: Probes compact dump with ensure_ascii on object keys consisting of plain ASCII versus non-ASCII.

tests.name: view_dump_pretty_ascii
tests.intent: Probes pretty-printing (indented dump) of json_view with ensure_ascii over mixed ASCII and escaped elements.

tests.name: view_dump_eight_byte_boundary_lengths
tests.intent: Probes strings around 8-byte boundaries with ensure_ascii to test the SWAR block loop and tail check.

tests.name: view_dump_source_numbers_ensure_ascii
tests.intent: Probes compact dump combining source_numbers and ensure_ascii options on a json_view.

tests.name: ordered_json_view_dump_mixed
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json_document view dumps with various indentation levels and ensure_ascii settings.

tests.name: view_dump_long_string_ascii
tests.intent: Probes dumping long purely ASCII strings exceeding multiple 8-byte blocks with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: view_dump_empty_string
tests.intent: Probes dumping an empty string inside a json_view with ensure_ascii enabled.

tests.name: view_dump_control_characters
tests.intent: Probes dumping strings containing control characters (e.g., \u0001, \u001f) with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: view_dump_escaped_quotes_and_slashes
tests.intent: Probes dumping strings with escaped quotes, backslashes, and slashes with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: view_dump_multiple_nested_types
tests.intent: Probes dumping a complex nested document structure via json_view with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: view_dump_unicode_tail_positions
tests.intent: Probes check for bytes >= 0x7F placed at various tail positions of short strings.

tests.name: view_dump_materialize_comparison
tests.intent: Probes equality of dump output between json_view with ensure_ascii and materialized json dump.

tests.name: view_dump_subelements
tests.intent: Probes dumping individual sub-elements of a json_view with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: view_dump_tab_separator
tests.intent: Probes dumping json_view with ensure_ascii using custom tab separators.

tests.name: view_dump_unindented_ascii
tests.intent: Probes compact unindented dump of json_view with ensure_ascii on a mixed array.

tests.name: view_dump_large_key_value_pairs
tests.intent: Probes dumping an object containing multiple ASCII keys and values with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: view_dump_mixed_ascii_unicode_keys
tests.intent: Probes dumping an object where some keys are purely ASCII and others contain unicode characters with ensure_ascii.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises dump_compact<true, false> by dumping a compact json_view with source_numbers enabled and ensure_ascii disabled.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises dump_compact<false, false> by dumping a compact json_view with both source_numbers and ensure_ascii disabled.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises dump_compact<true, true> in dump_compact_ascii by dumping a compact json_view with source_numbers and ensure_ascii both enabled.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises the std::false_type overload of copied via non-compact dump when ensure_ascii is false.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises the write_decoded path via escaped lambda when ensure_ascii is false on a non-ASCII string during compact dump.

tests.name: view_dump_source_numbers_ensure_ascii_fixed
tests.intent: Probes compact dump combining source_numbers and ensure_ascii options on a json_view.

tests.name: view_dump_empty_string_fixed
tests.intent: Probes dumping an empty string inside a json_view with ensure_ascii enabled.

tests.name: gen_21_fixed
tests.intent: Exercises dump_compact<true, false> by dumping a compact json_view with source_numbers enabled and ensure_ascii disabled.

tests.name: gen_23_fixed
tests.intent: Exercises dump_compact<true, true> in dump_compact_ascii by dumping a compact json_view with source_numbers and ensure_ascii both enabled.

tests.name: view_dump_empty_string_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Probes dumping an empty string inside a json_view with ensure_ascii enabled.
